title: Evidence Inventory to Reusable Component Map
architecture_layers: L1 Full-page visual capture (PDF pages, text, figures, graphs, equations, symbols)
L2 Detection and localization (bounding boxes, coordinates, page geometry, crops, overlays)
L3 Visual classification (math, graphs/plots, symbols, figures/diagrams, text/tables, unresolved)
L4 Mathematical recovery (OCR, glyph identity, delimiters, spatial structure, canonical AST)
L5 Visual data recovery (axes, curves, points, legends, units, error bars, figure structure)
L6 Provenance-preserving evidence registry (image + coordinates + classification + extraction + confidence)

arxiv_html_parser.py.purpose: Walks MathML tree, extracts <math> tags + <annotation x-tex> LaTeX source (991/991 on 2605.00155)
arxiv_html_parser.py.reusable: Yes - walk the <math> tree, extract annotation for LaTeX, preserve delimiter identity

targeted_math_detector.py.purpose: Targeted crops (z4 detection, z8 crops), bounding boxes, coordinate mapping
targeted_math_detector.py.evidence_entry: tocr-1212.0957_p8 (7-line tall delimiter visible in tall_narrow crops)
targeted_math_detector.py.reusable: Yes - detection pipeline for visual inclusion of non-math regions

vision_math_extractor.py.purpose: Classifies visual regions: math vs graph vs symbol vs figure vs text
vision_math_extractor.py.reusable: Yes - classification layer that routes regions instead of discarding them

math_recovery_tool.py.purpose: Full pipeline: fetch -> extract -> learn -> recover -> solve -> report
math_recovery_tool.py.reusable: Yes - canonical math recovery path; use AST + delimiter identity modules

delimiter_identity.py.purpose: Preserve bracket family identity: curly, round, square, double_bar, auto_left, etc.
delimiter_identity.py.reusable: Yes - normalization and preservation of delimiter identity across parsers

structural_ast_extractor.py.purpose: Extracts canonical AST from MathML tree, preserving structure; fallback when complex
structural_ast_extractor.py.reusable: Yes - parse LaTeX to AST for canonical representation before SymPy

bracket_analyzer.py.purpose: Analyzes bracket patterns: curly, round, square, extended, auto_left/right, accent_ext
bracket_analyzer.py.reusable: Yes - delimiter family classification for visual data recovery layer

adjudicate_candidates_v2.py.purpose: Adjudicates candidates to papers with classification, confidence, coordinates
adjudicate_candidates_v2.py.reusable: Yes - adjudication layer for evidence registry; does NOT discard non-math

six_class_routing.reason: Match_status taxonomy (5 values) is distinct from six-class visual taxonomy. Script does not distinguish plot vs equation vs symbol; it distinguishes spatial/text/visual adjudication.

add_provenance.py.purpose: Adds provenance metadata to extracted artifacts (source PDF, version, SHA-256)
add_provenance.py.reusable: Yes - provenance layer for audit trail

arxiv_provenance.py.purpose: Tracks paper version, arXiv URL, HTML URL, e-print source
